about: The bucket is a place someone stands in. Examined from the well or from inside it, it describes itself; looked from inside it, or arrived in, it describes the well seen from it.

expect.words: The bottom of a dry well. A bucket hangs on its rope.
A wooden bucket, banded with iron, big enough to stand in.
From the bucket you see the round stone walls of the well, and daylight far above.
